blocks.body: # PN3B: Did the raw prime record reveal the missing wave?

## Executive Summary

The unfiltered data does contain an additional two-coordinate organization: number-line position x the later gate at which a candidate is removed. R9's leading joint structure is stronger than margin-preserving permutations (p = 0.002). However, its orientation does not recur from R8 to R9, and the strongest R8/R9 Q29 residual frequency is exactly the third harmonic of period 62 = 2 x 31 within one Fourier bin. Under the frozen criteria, this does not support a separate scale-persistent candidate 'Time-like' wave. It says the second view is real, but the dominant repeatable signal still belongs to the connection/sieve side.

## What the second coordinate added

A one-axis prime/composite sequence hides how Q29 survivors are later removed. Adding future death-stage as a perpendicular coordinate exposes within-rung organization. That is useful evidence that the previous view was flattened. Yet the leading spatial and gate modes fail the cross-rung recurrence requirement (R8-R9 spatial p = 0.477; gate p = 0.377), so we cannot call the observed local organization the missing adult wave.

## ARA reading

Your diagnosis that we had measured a connection-heavy half was productive: the added coordinate recovers information that the one-line count discarded. But the data now distinguishes two statements. 'There is another coordinate' is supported inside some rungs. 'That coordinate is a common larger Time wave' is not supported by this representation. The prime record appears to contain state/connection plus the ordered sequence of future connection gates; it does not yet supply an independently recurring opposite pole.

## Limits and next safe inference

This is opened-data exploration, not blind prediction. It tests stationary Fourier phase in four fixed integer windows and one position-by-gate construction; failure does not prove that no dual process exists. The period-62 interpretation is a post-result arithmetic crosswalk and must not be promoted as a preregistered endpoint. The independent validator rebuilt counts, masks, coordinates, alignments and hashes without importing the primary module, but did not rerun the Monte Carlo simulations. The scientifically honest next move is to freeze a new representation only after deciding what observable would constitute information-flow independently of sieve survival--not simply to rename another prime-derived transform 'Time.'
